title: The Parks brass band, Carey, and playing solo alto
summary: Back in Parks, Charles says Carey taught the band, then he did; he started on solo alto because there was no trumpet for him.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: Yeah, let's get back to Parks. Now that band, that brass band that was going when you were young, you said it was very big, huh?
Oh yeah, it was very big, but Kerry was teaching it then. And when Kerry stopped, I'm the one who used to handle it.
Did you give us all the names of the men that were playing when you were just starting?

Oh, if I can think of all of them, I should give them to you. Let me see which one I could name first. That was, because that time I was playing solo alto when I first started with them. Oh, your first instrument was solo alto? Solo alto. Because for the simple fact, they didn't have no trumpet for me. You see, Kerry was the cause when I got into the band, you see. Because my father, he didn't want me to go into the band, but Kerry claimed that I was doing so well, when my father would go away I'd take his baritone with you and his thing. He'd take his baritone and I'd go to play. And so like I said, by me taking care of Kerry's buggy and horse, he used to come catch me fooling around with that baritone. And he thought I had an idea about music, you see. So that's how he come to see that I had to get in the band. And when you come to Fire Out, I woke up from that solo alto all the way to the front.

Were there any white musicians that were involved studying with Mr. Kerry and someone like this? Or did he just, he worked entirely with the Negro people? That's right. That's right. That's perfectly amazing. That's right.

Because they had only one band here that was really playing music then, that was the Brobridge band. Yeah. That was Belle Melençon and them, Jean Fourjeau and them, Dr. Fourjeau and all of them. They used to have, oh they had a wonderful band, but that was a regular brass band. But they used to use a few pieces and go around playing like that during the time they had election and things like that. But they had a good band.
